dish_name_kh: ពងទាបឬពងមាន់ចៀន (Omelette)

ingredients.raw_kh: ពងទាបឬពងមាន់

steps.text_kh: យកខ្ទះដាក់ខ្លាញ់ដាំឱ្យក្តៅ គោះពងមាន់ ដាក់លើខ្ទះ រោយអំបិល ស្ករ
steps.text_en: Heat a pan with oil; beat the eggs, pour onto the pan, and sprinkle with salt and sugar.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer other dish Omelette (Duck or Chicken Egg), step 1: Heat a pan with oil; beat the eggs, pour onto the pan, and sprinkle with salt and sugar.

steps.text_kh: ម្រេច ត្រឡប់រួចដួសដាក់ចាន ជាការស្រេច
steps.text_en: Add black pepper, flip once cooked, then scoop onto a plate to serve.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer other dish Omelette (Duck or Chicken Egg), step 2: Add black pepper, flip once cooked, then scoop onto a plate to serve.
